pieces.Text: You can use your innate magic to create minor illusions that augment your efforts at trickery and deceit.
As long as you have at least one spell-like ability unused from your gnome magic racial trait, you gain a +2 racial bonus on all Bluff, Disguise, and Sleight of Hand checks you make.
As long as you have at least one spell-like ability unused from your gnome magic racial trait, you gain a +4 racial bonus on all Bluff, Disguise, and Sleight of Hand checks you make.
